name: Storm-2945 (CaptiveCrunch)
description: Microsoft Threat Intelligence disclosed "CaptiveCrunch," a Midnight Blizzard sub-cluster campaign manipulating hotel/conference-venue Wi-Fi captive-portal DNS/HTTP traffic to redirect corporate travelers to phishing pages since early May 2026, and running AI-augmented device-code and OAuth-code phishing against Microsoft Entra ID since February 2026. Microsoft states it "observed Storm-2945 leveraging AI to support a significant portion of these operations." Deployed malware includes CornFlake (Golang Windows RAT), ChocoShell (a PowerShell infostealer whose "consistent coding standard and descriptive commentary suggest the author might have leveraged AI-assisted code generation"), and the FruitStone web C2 panel; the actor also abused a Chrome App-Bound Encryption bypass for session-token theft. Microsoft
